Canopy

Checking a Tent

See a space's inventory while you are standing in it.

StatusShipped
Date21 September 2026
Commitf77c263
ScreensSpaces → check contents

What we wanted

A way to see a space's inventory while standing in that space, so the app and the tent can be audited against each other.

Without it, three plants sat wrong in the database for 10 to 20 days each, and all three were found by accident.

PlantCanopy saidThe tent saidWrong for
Sour DieselIn veg, never flippedIn flower since 1 Sep, 3 gallon20 days
Jack HererIn vegIn flower since 4 Sep10 days
SSDD IIIHarvested 30 AugStill standing in flower19 days

So we built this

A plant you cannot find is flagged, not killed

"I did not see it" and "it is gone" are different. A plant can be missed because it is behind a taller one, two share a pot, the label faded, or you were tired.

So the check writes nothing but notes. Unticked plants get Not found in the 2026-09-21 check of Veg Tent. appended, and one journal entry records 30 of 35 confirmed with their names. No status changes, no end dates, no moves. A test asserts that.

There is also a box for anything in the tent that is not on the page. Sour D was not missing from veg — it was in the flower tent, which the app knew nothing about.

What it does not do

  • Does not say where a missing plant went. You flag it missing in one space and report it unlisted in another; joining those up is manual.
  • "Here but not in Canopy" is free text. It does not offer to create the plant.
  • Nothing prompts a check. No cadence, no reminder.
  • Where several seeds share a pot, one row can stand for more than one plant.
